description:
Abe RE is an SDL3 fork of the game "Abe's Amazing Adventure!!", which is a
side-scrolling platformer inspired by the game "Tom" for Commodore Plus/4.

Long years have passed since his friend disappeared. Now Abe braves the
deadly twisting passages of the great pyramid! He seeks to free his friend
and uncover the mystery of the depths.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
